editorNote: Safety and legal pressure on chatbot makers dominates the day. Eight US states sued OpenAI over child safety, researchers say new image models from OpenAI and Google are easy to push into making nudes, and Anthropic warned that small models could spread across IoT devices. On the build side, Hugging Face described a cheaper way to simulate extreme weather at 3 km, and YouTube started labeling AI-generated songs.
